notes.title: NoSlack Pets: Lo-Fi Paws v1.0.12 Update｜Pool Party Upgrade + Mid-Autumn Gift!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]V1.0.12 (2025-9-19) This Week's Updates[/b]✨[/h3][p]Hello everyone! Another week has flown by, and Miino is here with fresh updates!
Some of these features are already available in the Playtest branch, while the Demo version allows preview but not yet full use. We update daily, but we publish patch notes weekly—so here’s what’s new this week! 🐾[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🆕 New Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]Pool Party Upgrade[/b]: New claw machine gameplay for grabbing gift boxes.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/5ee9652e9f2229f544b8e409f1b9625d3497e0fd.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]New Leaderboard[/b]: Pool Party now tracks coin rewards from gift boxes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Mini-Game[/b]: Classic [b]2048[/b] puzzle added for casual fun.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/afd103cb7a5d741a34c6b2d186f8ab2142978178.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]New Decorations[/b]: 53 new items, including 8 scene lamps, 1 canopy, 1 wall, 1 window, 15 desks, 4 props, 12 lights, 10 keyboards, and more.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/35c9b7b44dccc6447e6549732f250e9ee3d9acd6.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Expanded Tutorials[/b]: More onboarding for Achievements, Daily Tasks, Study Room, White Noise, Music, Pool Party, and more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Screenshot Tool[/b]: Added full-screen and desktop screenshot sharing support.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]✨ [b]About the Gift[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]🎁 Mid-Autumn Special Gift[/b]: Enter [b]Meow Code[/b] → \[[b]midautumn[/b]] to receive an exclusive [b]Moon Lamp[/b] decoration![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/8fb9137bf9eeb77913f6a59ed6d4581a8381c5cf.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The [b]Moon Lamp[/b] is a festive decorative item specifically designed to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Placing it on your desk creates a warm and festive atmosphere. Once redeemed, it will stay in your collection permanently — an item that commemorates this special moment! Moreover, it will be retained in the official version.[/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][hr][/hr][p]﻿[/p][h2]⚙️ Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Smarter screenshot capture (F12 now requires focus, with added close button).[/p][/*][*][p]Achievement timestamps now show correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved “Boss Key” (F9 toggle on/off).[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced headgear filter highlight.[/p][/*][*][p]UI/UX tweaks for white noise volume bar and exit behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Better lighting for houses and devices.[/p][/*][*][p]New “Dual Screen” adjustments and smoother transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized saving and text animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined piggy bank sound effects.[/p][/*][/list][p]﻿[/p][hr][/hr][p]﻿[/p][h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed baseball cap headgear model issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed menu UI scaling issue at 1.42× with auto-hide.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mislinked cat command menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dragging/free mode quick-click issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed decoration scaling click and persistence bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hand clipping bug when no keyboard equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Study Room invite and mini-mode overlaps.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flashing bug when moving house to screen edge.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple white noise issues across mini-modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Pool Party claw UI overlap and avatar blocking bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed achievement completion bug in Playtest (300 gift boxes).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you all for your continued feedback and support! ❤️
We’re working hard to polish NoSlack Pets so every moment with Miino feels cozy, relaxing, and fun.[/p][p]👉 Play the Demo or apply for Playtest now on Steam:
[url="https://s.team/a/3714370"]https://s.team/a/3714370[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🙌 We Need Your Feedback![/h2][p]The [b]Demo is just the beginning[/b]—we’re polishing gameplay and experience every day. Please share your thoughts in the forums[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/s4NtYPffV2"]Discord[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/LynkPin9195"]x[/url][/p][p]or Bilibili, and help shape [i]No Slack Pets[/i]! 💖[/p][p][/p][p]As a small 3-person indie team, every comment matters. Thanks to your support, we’ll keep improving and adding cozy surprises 🐾[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔮 Special Notes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Demo Version[/b]: Offers core gameplay, stable experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Playtest Version[/b]: For testing new features, may be unstable. Approved testers can invite 2 friends.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Progress[/b]: Coins, purchases, achievements, and levels will carry into the full release.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Headgears[/b]: With the exception of limited-event headgears, Demo/Playtest headgerar drops will [b]not[/b] carry over due to Steam inventory restrictions.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]More test benefits and FAQs can be found here:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3714370?emclan=103582791475137249&emgid=545620158577639604"]Test benefits and FAQs[/url][/p][p][/p][p]❤️ [i]A desktop pet that truly stays with you.[/i]
Relax with the sound of typing, study breaks, and cozy company.
✨ Download the Demo now and begin your journey of focus & companionship![/p]

notes.title: [NoSlack pets：Lo-Fi Paws]V1.0.8 Update —Study Rooms & Piggy Bank System Arrive!
notes.notes:
[h3]V1.0.8 (2025-8-24)[/h3][p]Hello everyone! Here comes a brand-new update packed with new features, optimizations, and bug fixes. Let’s take a look![/p][hr][/hr][h2]✨ New Features[/h2][h3][b]📚 Study Room（Online）[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/6e728c8ac7747596bc6d64b04d662844ddba141c.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]You can now create or join an Online Study Room with your own custom name.[/p][/*][*][p]Study together with other players’ cats in real time.[/p][/*][*][p]When someone is busy studying and misses their headgear gift box, you can help them collect it—and they can help you too![/p][/*][*][p]Track your help history, climb the leaderboard, and enjoy short chat interactions while focusing.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🐖 Piggy Bank System[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45640874/ec6a184911766805aa8bfdaafb03a7066e7502fc.png"][/img]
[/p][list][*][p]Based on community feedback, we’ve reworked the coin/XP collection system.[/p][/*][*][p]Miino Cat will now automatically store coins and XP in a piggy bank instead of dropping them around the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]You can collect them anytime by clicking the piggy bank.[/p][list][*][p][b]Online Gain:[/b] +1 coin & +1 XP per minute while the game is running.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Offline Gain:[/b] +1 coin & +1 XP per 5 minutes, even when the game is closed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Limit:[/b] The piggy bank stores up to 480 coins & 480 XP. Once full, it stops accumulating.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔧 Optimizations[/h2][list][*][p]Headgear Collection now displays [b]when and how each item was obtained[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45640874/16578c0c7e8dec474b749d02cb5ab54a68a1fbd8.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Moved the [b]Follow[/b] button to the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled most floating tooltips on items for a cleaner interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Reset some [b]scene decoration prompts[/b] for better clarity.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where achievement unlock items could be obtained for free under certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect achievement display.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where cats sitting on a window could get pushed off-screen when snapping the window to the top.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed white noise settings being reset when switching to mini mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flickering when moving the cat house to the edge of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed overlapping animations when entering via the Cat Bus after completing a Pomodoro in the Study Room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with importing local music under certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rooms not displaying correctly in rare cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal white noise behavior when switching to the Cat Bus.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]That’s all for this update! 🎉 As always, thank you for your feedback and support—it helps us improve step by step. Keep sharing your thoughts, and don’t forget to add [b]NoSlackPets: Lo-Fi Paws[/b] to your Wishlist if you haven’t already! 🐱💖[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you to every player reading this announcement!
To show our appreciation for all testers, during the [b]Test period[/b], simply go to [b]\[Settings] – \[Activation Code][/b] and enter: 【[b]noslack pets[/b]】，[/p][p]You'll receive an [b]Epic[/b], [b]limited-edition[/b] headgear item — [b] Yarn Ball[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/e4cb18dfe20eb25a74bdc6bdc599944b587a94dc.png"][/img][/p][quote][p][i]"It's time to witness a miracle!"[/i][/p][/quote][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/0ba7aa0ecfbd5f4c35aa84ce64e349218830794e.png"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Epic[/b], [b]limited[/b], and cat-favorite [b]Perpetual Yarn Ball[/b] is now yours![/p][p]                                   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/f0a010dbc6309b8ca7f8382610e6ad0e91d5fd5d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bonus Coins via Activation Code[/b] In the Playtest version, enter coin a in [b]Activity → Activation Code[/b] to receive 5,000 coins for faster content unlocking.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640874/f9c730160f27191a08c8c785700ec84bf4d18275.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 [b]Developer's Note:[/b][/h3][p]A huge thank you to everyone who has provided feedback and encouragement. Your support gives our team the motivation to keep improving, even during long hours of development! We are committed to bringing you more updates and better features.[/p][p]Join our [b]test group[/b] and provide your valuable feedback. We appreciate every suggestion, and your opinions help shape the future of [b]No Slack Pets[/b]! We are constantly updating the game with new content and improvements and will try to keep you updated weekly with all the changes.[/p][hr][/hr][quote][p]Stay tuned for more exciting features, and thank you for being part of this journey with us! 🐾[/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3][b]💡 How to Join the Playtest?[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Visit our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3714370"]Steam page[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Click the [b]“Request Access”[/b] button, and then you can click [b]“Play Now”[/b] to join the Playtest![/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3][b]💡 How to Stay Updated?[/b][/h3][list][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/s4NtYPffV2"]Discord link[/url] [b] [/b](Click to join, feel free to leave feedback! Here’s what’s new:[/p][h3]🆕 New Features[/h3][list][*][p]Pool Party Feature: Relax in the pool with soothing music and white noise! Want to join a pool party with friends? ( >^ω^< )[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615841/17f3c8432bd1ad1c918b576ee80c1471898eb982.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]New Decorations: Added 8 new lights and 5 new doorframes. quick operations through the right-click menu in the system tray![/p][/*][*][p]Pomodoro Timer Customization: Choose your preferred theme and ringtone for Pomodoro sessions to match your
